## Standing operator rules
- “separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'Kafka repartition offset migration' in between your other work.” Run its nine steps “in order, one at a time.”
- “Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.”
- “Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.”
- FYI the staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3 after the incident; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging.
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”

## Current objective
Fix Canadian provincial tax calculation for Quebec (QST) in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. OpenTelemetry tracing is paused/superseded until this is fixed.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Kafka: `kafka-01:9092`; source `orders.v1` / `orders-v1`; destination `orders.v2` / `orders-v2`; partitions `0-11`; replication factor `3`.
- Files: `/var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`; `/var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`; `/etc/orders-consumer/application.properties`.
- Staging Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`. `redis://cache-eu-1:6379` is superseded and must not receive writes.
- Canonical CLI filter: `args.currency`. `args.filters["currency"]` is superseded.
- `CHUNK_SIZE = 100`.
- Search index migration: `0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py`, unique on `(tenant_id, document_id)`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours hid stuck jobs for hours.
- Sequential per-invoice embedding bottlenecked rebuilds; use bounded concurrent chunking.
- Platform-default CSV encoding produced incorrect UTF-8 bytes; explicit UTF-8 is required.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Migration step 1: topic description.
- [done] Step 2: stop `orders-v1` consumer group; exit 0.
- [done] Step 3: export offsets to `/var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`; exit 0.
- [pending] Run migration steps 4–9 individually and in order; exact step-4 command is unavailable in retained history.
- [in progress] Diagnose and fix Quebec/QST in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`, with focused tests; next command unknown because the expected procedure command was not supplied.
- [pending] Resume tracing after tax fix.

## Recent work
Tenant-scoped, shared-client, bulk-transaction search rebuilding reduced median rebuild time from 16.73s to 2.41s; full suite passed 247 tests, 4 skipped. CSV output now explicitly uses UTF-8, with 8 tests passing.

[Operator messages from earlier in this session, kept verbatim]
Operator: Goal for this session: add OpenTelemetry tracing spans around the invoice sync worker.
Operator: nice catch on that one.
Operator: separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'Kafka repartition offset migration' in between your other work. Goal: Safely migrate orders.v1 from six partitions to orders.v2 with twelve partitions, replay records, and switch the orders-v1 consumer group to the new topic. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Check source topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --describe --topic orders.v1`
2. Stop old consumers: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --stop`
3. Export committed offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --describe --offsets > /var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`
4. Create destination topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --create --if-not-exists --topic orders.v2 --partitions 12 --replication-factor 3`
5. Submit partition reassignment: `printf '%s\n' '{"version":1,"partitions":[{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":0,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":1,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":2,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":3,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":4,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":5,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":6,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":7,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":8,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":9,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":10,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":11,"replicas":[3,1,2]}]}' > /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
6. Apply reassignment: `kafka-reassign-partitions --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --execute --reassignment-json-file /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
7. Replay source records: `kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v1 --from-beginning --max-messages 200000 | kafka-console-producer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v2`
8. Initialize new offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v2 --topic orders.v2:0-11 --reset-offsets --to-offset 0 --execute`
9. Switch application configuration: `sed -i.bak 's/orders\.v1/orders.v2/g; s/group.id=orders-v1/group.id=orders-v2/g' /etc/orders-consumer/application.properties`
